LanguageData.LP_SkeletonSeed.label: skeleton servant seed
LanguageData.LP_SkeletonSeed.description: A necromantic seed made from raw meat. Select it and open "configure necromantic construct" to adjust extra raw meat, steel, plasteel and starting stats, then confirm to awaken it. Materials are absorbed from reachable, unforbidden ground items within 12 cells.
